Counsel for Applicant :- Arjun Singh Somvanshi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Arjun Singh Somvanshi, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Sri Niwas
Bajpai, the learned A.G.A. for the State

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
321 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Prohibition
Act, registered at Police Station Atrauli, District Hardoi.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 06.07.2022 against the applicant, his father, mother and sister, stating that the informant has got his daughter married to the applicant about 4 years ago; that all the accused persons used to harass her for demanding dowry and they killed her for the aforesaid reason.
4. The post mortem examination report of the deceased mentions a ligature mark around her neck interrupted by 5 cm and the cause of death has been opined to be Asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging.

sentences.text: 5. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that one of the co-accused Hanuman Singh has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 17.10.2022 passed by a coordinate bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 11765 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 11765 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R contains general allegation against four accused persons, two of whom have already been exonerated during investigation and the other co-accused Hanuman Singh has already been granted bail and that the cause of death as been opined to be Asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging,
coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 09.07.2022 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
8.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 17.5.2023/Preeti.
